description: In a nonempty structure, a complete formula with empty free support is satisfied under every assignment exactly when it is satisfied under any chosen assignment.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderSemantics.noFreeVar_realize_all_iff.{u, v, w, u'} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {M : Type w} [L.Structure M] {α : Type u'} [Nonempty M] [DecidableEq α] (φ : L.Formula α)
  (h : FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.freeVarFinset φ = ∅) (a : α → M) :
  (∀ (a' : α → M), φ.Realize a') ↔ φ.Realize a
